output.summary: A user with rheumatoid arthritis on weekly methotrexate asked whether to quit because of severe nausea. The bot explained options (splitting the dose, moving folic acid off the methotrexate day, anti-nausea medicine, injection), advised against stopping on their own, gave warning signs needing earlier care, and helped draft questions for the appointment in two weeks. The user said they felt much better and would start the changes that weekend.
